name: Ahe Hime (1) - Seiso de Seijun na Hime-sama ga Shasei to Douji ni Kyouseiteki ni Iku!
original_name: あへ姫(1) 清楚で清純な姫様が射精と同時に強制的にイクッ!
source:
Love and harmony is disrupted royally for one innocent majesty!
She's fallen like a plummeting rock made of slut flesh!

The traitor of the kingdom overthrows her and puts her in jail of the "dimension".
The feast of eternal pleasure started, to disgrace the pretty princess...

Purity polluted! Exquisite o-o-orgasmmnhhh!

translation:
一位純真君主原本充滿愛與和諧的生活，就此徹底崩塌！
她如同墜落的岩石一般，迅速淪為任人玩弄的淫婦！

王國的叛徒推翻了她的統治，將她囚禁在「異次元」的牢獄之中。
為了羞辱這位美麗的公主，一場永無止境的歡愉盛宴就此拉開帷幕……

純潔遭到玷汙！令人欲罷不能的高……高潮！
